description: TypeScript type definitions for the jQuery library, version 1.10.x / 2.0.x, including interfaces for AJAX settings, jQuery objects, events, and static methods.

classes.name: JQueryAjaxSettings
classes.description: Interface defining settings for jQuery AJAX requests.

classes.name: JQueryXHR
classes.description: Interface extending XMLHttpRequest with additional jQuery-specific methods.

classes.name: JQueryCallback
classes.description: Interface for jQuery callback list objects.

classes.name: JQueryGenericPromise
classes.description: Interface for jQuery promises with generic type support.

classes.name: JQueryPromise
classes.description: Interface for jQuery promise objects with callback methods.

classes.name: JQueryDeferred
classes.description: Interface for jQuery deferred objects, extending promises with resolve/reject capabilities.

classes.name: BaseJQueryEventObject
classes.description: Interface representing the jQuery extension of the W3C Event object.

classes.name: JQueryEventObject
classes.description: Composite interface for various jQuery event objects.

classes.name: JQueryParam
classes.description: Function interface for serializing objects into query strings.

classes.name: JQueryEventConstructor
classes.description: Interface for constructing jQuery event objects.

classes.name: JQueryEasing
classes.description: Interface for easing functions used in animations.

classes.name: JQueryStatic
classes.description: Static interface representing the jQuery namespace with methods and properties.

methods.name: ajax
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous HTTP (Ajax) request with given settings.

methods.name: ajaxPrefilter
methods.description: Handles custom Ajax options or modifies existing options before each request.

methods.name: ajaxSetup
methods.description: Sets default values for future Ajax requests.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Loads data from the server using a HTTP GET request.

methods.name: getJSON
methods.description: Loads JSON data from the server using a GET request.

methods.name: getScript
methods.description: Loads and executes a JavaScript file from the server.

methods.name: param
methods.description: Serializes an object into a query string.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Loads data from the server using a HTTP POST request.

methods.name: Callbacks
methods.description: Creates a callback list object.

methods.name: holdReady
methods.description: Holds or releases the execution of jQuery's ready event.

methods.name: when
methods.description: Executes callback functions based on one or more Deferred objects.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Stores or retrieves arbitrary data associated with DOM elements.

methods.name: hasData
methods.description: Checks if an element has associated data.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Manipulates the queue of functions to be executed on an element.

methods.name: removeData
methods.description: Removes data associated with an element.

methods.name: Deferred
methods.description: Creates a new Deferred object.

methods.name: proxy
methods.description: Creates a proxy function that maintains context.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Handles error messages.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Merges the contents of two or more objects into the first object.

methods.name: globalEval
methods.description: Evaluates a string of JavaScript code globally.

methods.name: grep
methods.description: Filters an array based on a callback function.

methods.name: inArray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists in an array.
